data.title: Global Talent Scholarship 2026/27 awarded
data.summary: The Global Talent Scholarship Foundation awarded you a scholarship for 2026/27 with a monthly stipend of €450 from October 2026 to September 2027. The first progress report is due on 15 December 2026.
data.explanation: Congratulations: you have received a scholarship (Stipendium) of €450 per month for 12 months, paid by bank transfer around the first working day of each month. Conditions: stay enrolled full-time, upload your enrolment certificate each semester, submit a progress report countersigned by your supervisor by 15 December 2026, report changes of address, bank details or study status within two weeks, and report other scholarships before accepting them. The letter says the stipend is generally tax-free; keep it for your records. A separate invitation to the Autumn Meeting on 7 November 2026 will follow.
data.tax_note: The letter states the scholarship is generally tax-free under § 3 No. 44 EStG; keep it as proof of this income.

items.title: Monthly scholarship stipend

date.text: on or around the first working day of each month

items.quote: The monthly stipend of EUR 450.00 will be paid from October 2026 to September 2027 by bank transfer on or around the first working day of each month.

items.title: Submit first progress report
items.quote: Your first progress report is due on 15 December 2026.
items.action: Submit the progress report (max. two pages), countersigned by your academic supervisor, via the scholarship portal.

items.title: Upload enrolment certificate each semester
items.quote: You remain enrolled as a full-time student at Hochschule Musterstadt throughout the funding period and upload your certificate of enrolment for each semester to the scholarship portal.
items.action: Upload your certificate of enrolment to the scholarship portal every semester.

items.title: Report changes to the foundation

date.text: within two weeks of the change

items.quote: Please notify us of any change of address, bank details or study status within two weeks of the change.
items.action: Notify the foundation of any change of address, bank details or study status within two weeks.

items.title: Autumn Meeting of scholars in Berlin
items.quote: We look forward to welcoming you to our scholar community at the Autumn Meeting in Berlin on 7 November 2026.
items.action: Attend; a separate invitation with the programme will follow.
